title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Implementing the Spirit of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and Advancing the Modernization of the Trial System and Trial Capability of the People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Implementing the Spirit of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and Advancing the Modernization of the Trial System and Trial Capability

Fa Fa [2020] No. 9

In order to thoroughly study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, fully implement the spirit of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, focus on upholding and improving the socialist system with Chinese characteristics and advancing the modernization of the national governance system and governance capability, fully leverage the functional role of the people's courts, accelerate the modernization of the trial system and trial capability, promote the better transformation of China's institutional advantages into national governance effectiveness, and in light of actual work, the following opinions are formulated.

1. Effectively enhance the sense of responsibility and mission of the people's courts in implementing the spirit of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and advancing the modernization of the trial system and trial capability

The Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China specially studied the issues of upholding and improving the socialist system with Chinese characteristics and advancing the modernization of the national governance system and governance capability, fully reflecting the far-sighted strategic vision and strong historical responsibility of the Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core. This has significant and far-reaching significance for securing a decisive victory in building a moderately prosperous society in all respects, comprehensively building a modern socialist country, consolidating the Party's governing status, and ensuring the long-term stability and security of the Party and the country. Socialist rule of law in China is the most basic, most stable, and most reliable guarantee of institutional governance and is an important support for the national governance system and governance capability. The modernization of the trial system and trial capability is an important component of the modernization of the national governance system and governance capability, an effective way to accelerate the establishment of a fair, efficient, and authoritative socialist judicial system, and a necessary requirement to provide strong judicial services and guarantees for economic and social development. People's courts at all levels must adhere to Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as guidance, thoroughly implement the spirit of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, enhance the "Four Consciousnesses," strengthen the "Four Confidences," and achieve the "Two Upholds." They must uphold the Party's absolute leadership over judicial work, adhere to the path of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics, take deepening judicial system reform as the driving force, comprehensively build smart courts as the support, and build a capable team as the organizational guarantee. Centering on the goal of "ensuring that the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case," they must accelerate the modernization of the trial system and trial capability, promote the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics to become more mature and finalized, improve the rule of law guarantee system for social fairness and justice, enhance the effectiveness of the rule of law in promoting the modernization of the governance system and governance capability, and strive to provide strong judicial services and guarantees for upholding and improving the socialist system with Chinese characteristics, advancing the modernization of the national governance system and governance capability, realizing the "Two Centenary Goals," and realizing the Chinese Dream of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

2. Firmly uphold the Party's absolute leadership over judicial work and unswervingly follow the path of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics

Unremittingly strengthen theoretical armed forces, always use Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era to arm the mind, guide practice, and promote work. Adhere to placing the Party's political construction in the first place. Adhere to taking "remain true to our original aspiration and keep our mission firmly in mind" as an eternal topic for strengthening the Party building of the people's courts and a lifelong topic for the majority of court personnel, study and form practical and feasible long-term mechanisms, and temper the political character of loyalty, integrity, and responsibility. Strictly implement the system and mechanism for firmly maintaining the authority of the Central Committee and its centralized, unified leadership, carry out political training solidly, educate and guide court personnel to continuously enhance the "Four Consciousnesses," strengthen the "Four Confidences," and achieve the "Two Upholds," consciously maintain a high degree of consistency in thought, politics, and action with the Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, and resolutely implement the maintenance of Comrade Xi Jinping's core position in the Central Committee and the entire Party. Improve the system and mechanism for implementing the Party's overall leadership, strictly implement the "Regulations of the Communist Party of China on Political and Legal Work," and effectively apply Party leadership to all areas, aspects, and links of the people's courts' work, ensuring the independent and impartial exercise of judicial power under the leadership of the Party. Improve the implementation mechanism for the Central Committee's major decisions, strictly implement the system of reporting to the Central Committee for instructions, strengthen the system for reporting on the rectification of political inspections and judicial inspections, and the implementation of supervision reports, ensuring the smooth flow of government decrees and orders, and compliance with prohibitions. Adhere to the Party's organizational line for the new era, improve the people's courts' system and mechanism for Party management of cadres and selecting the capable, and in accordance with the requirements of political integrity, professional competence, responsibility, discipline, and work style, build a revolutionary, standardized, professional, and specialized people's court team.

3. Adhere to the principal position of the people, fully reflect the will of the people and protect the rights and interests of the people in judicial work

Always uphold the system of people's congresses, consciously accept the supervision of the people's congress and its standing committee, report on trial and enforcement work to the people's congress and its standing committee in accordance with the law and procedures, and effectively implement the decisions and resolutions of the people's congress and its standing committee. If new situations arise in trial and enforcement work that require clarification of the applicable legal basis, the Supreme People's Court shall submit to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress a proposal for a legal interpretation or a bill for formulating or amending relevant laws. During the judicial reform process, if there is a need to adjust the application of relevant laws, pilot programs must be carried out only after obtaining authorization from the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress in accordance with the law. Judicial interpretations issued by the Supreme People's Court shall be promptly reported to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for filing in accordance with procedures. Consciously accept supervision by the people's congress, democratic supervision, and supervision from all parties, improve the mechanism for contacting representatives and committee members, improve the working mechanism for handling suggestions from deputies to the people's congress and proposals from members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, and optimize the communication and liaison mechanism with democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce, and non-party personages. Implement the People's Juror Law and its supporting judicial interpretations and normative documents, effectively carry out the selection, participation in trials, training, management, and publicity of people's jurors, ensure the orderly participation of the people in judicial activities, and promote judicial fairness. Punish illegal and criminal acts that undermine elections in accordance with the law, properly hear cases involving infringement of voter qualifications, and protect citizens' right to vote and the right to be elected.

4. Strive to enhance the ability to serve the overall situation, actively serve and guarantee economic and social development

Focusing on fighting the three critical battles, improve the risk monitoring and early warning mechanism in the financial trial field, properly hear financial dispute cases in accordance with the law, and actively prevent and resolve financial risks; study and formulate opinions of the people's courts on guaranteeing the reform of the rural land system, publish typical cases of judicial services guaranteeing the fight against poverty and rural revitalization strategy; fully implement the environmental public interest litigation system, improve the ecological environmental protection and restoration responsibility system, improve the environmental protection injunction system, deepen the reform of the jurisdiction system for environmental resource cases, and better serve the construction of a beautiful China. Focusing on evaluation indicators such as "enforcing contracts" and "handling bankruptcy," strengthen trial management, improve trial mechanisms, enhance trial quality and efficiency, and strive to create a stable, fair, transparent, and predictable law-based business environment. Strengthen the review of the legality of administrative actions, strengthen the substantive resolution of administrative disputes, serve the reform of "streamlining administration, delegating power, strengthening regulation, and improving services," and promote the construction of a law-based government. Strengthen judicial protection of property rights, identify and correct wrongful convictions in property rights cases in accordance with the law, promote the improvement of various market transaction rules, promote the improvement of the legal system for property rights protection, and serve the construction of a modern economic system. Study and formulate judicial interpretations on punitive damages for intellectual property rights, promote the establishment of an infringement damage compensation system that reflects the market value of intellectual property rights, study and formulate judicial interpretations on hearing cases of trade secret infringement, and continuously improve the level of judicial protection of intellectual property rights. Advance the construction of trial capacity for foreign-related commercial and maritime cases, equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties in accordance with the law, improve the diversified resolution mechanism for international commercial disputes, serve the joint construction of the "Belt and Road" and the construction of pilot free trade zones and free trade ports, and assist in the construction of a new system for a higher-level open economy. Closely rely on the leadership of the Party committee, actively integrate into the social governance system, better play the role of the judiciary in participating in, promoting, regulating, and guaranteeing social governance, insist on placing non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms at the forefront, improve the mechanism of "diversion, mediation, expedited adjudication, and fast trial," comprehensively advance the construction of a one-stop diversified dispute resolution and litigation service system, and provide the people with hierarchical, multi-channel, efficient, and low-cost dispute resolution solutions. Improve the trial working mechanism for cases involving Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan, build a centralized and professional trial system, explore and improve the diversified resolution mechanism for disputes involving Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan, and comprehensively, equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of compatriots from Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan in accordance with the law. Deepen the mechanism for international judicial exchange and cooperation, participate in the reform of the global governance system and the formulation of international legal rules, and contribute more Chinese wisdom to maintaining the multilateral trading system and international rule of law.

5. Improve the system and mechanism for practicing and promoting core socialist values, strictly implement the responsibility system for ideological work

Adhere to the guiding position of Marxism in the ideological field, strictly implement the responsibility system for ideological work, and resolutely prevent and resist the erosion and influence of erroneous Western ideological trends. Strengthen research on ideological work under internet conditions, fully leverage the functional role of trials, enhance the judicial governance capability of the internet, and create a clean and orderly cyberspace. Seriously implement the Outline for the Implementation of Civic Moral Construction in the New Era, properly hear cases involving social morality and codes of conduct in accordance with the law, and establish a clear and correct moral orientation. Adhere to the combination of rule of law and rule of virtue, improve the supporting mechanism for deeply integrating core socialist values into trial and enforcement work, and fully leverage the guiding role of judicial interpretations, judicial policies, and adjudication rules. Seriously implement the responsibility system for law popularization that "those who enforce the law should popularize the law," strengthen news and public opinion work, improve and refine the mechanism for publishing typical cases, establish behavioral rules and promote social customs through fair adjudication, and create a good rule of law environment.

6. Adhere to law-based prevention, control, and governance, actively promote the improvement of the national public health emergency management system

Thoroughly implement the spirit of a series of important speeches by General Secretary Xi Jinping on comprehensively improving law-based prevention, control, and governance capabilities and improving the national public health emergency management system, improve the institutional mechanism, and enhance the ability and level of the people's courts to provide services and guarantees for responding to major emergencies. Always put the people's life safety and physical health first, based on judicial functions, promote the improvement of the working mechanism combining prevention and treatment, joint prevention and control, and mass prevention and mass treatment. Severely punish various illegal and criminal acts such as hindering epidemic prevention and control, violent attacks on medical personnel, manufacturing and selling counterfeit and shoddy goods, price gouging, fraud, mass robbery, rumor-mongering, dereliction of duty in prevention and control, and destruction of wildlife resources in accordance with the law, protect people's rights and interests, and maintain social stability. Fully leverage the role of the one-stop diversified dispute resolution and litigation service system, handle civil cases such as contract performance, medical disputes, product quality, and labor disputes arising during the epidemic prevention and control period in accordance with the law, and promote the prevention and resolution of conflicts and disputes at the source. Cooperate in the formulation or revision and improvement of laws and regulations such as the Biosafety Law, the Law on the Prevention and Treatment of Infectious Diseases, and the Wildlife Protection Law, and promote the improvement of the national public health field laws, regulations, and institutional guarantee system.

7. Deepen the comprehensive supporting reform of the judicial system, promote the improvement of a fair, efficient, and authoritative socialist judicial system

Deepen the comprehensive supporting reform of the judicial responsibility system, improve and implement the case-handling responsibility system for single-judge tribunals and collegiate benches, improve the adjudication committee system, improve the judicial power supervision and restraint mechanism, strictly implement the accountability system for illegal adjudication, improve the judge disciplinary mechanism, and fully implement the judicial responsibility system. Promote the formulation of regulations such as the separate post sequence for judges, improve the judge post number exit and dynamic management mechanism. Promote the improvement of relevant policies and supporting safeguard measures for the progressive selection of judges. Improve the working mechanism of the circuit courts of the Supreme People's Court, and promote the construction of the Intellectual Property Court and the International Commercial Court of the Supreme People's Court. Promote the improvement of the organizational system of intellectual property courts, and improve the specialized trial system that conforms to the law of judicial protection of intellectual property rights. Deeply advance the reform of the criminal procedure system centered on trials, adhere to the trial as the center, strictly implement the "Three Regulations," standardize the handling mechanism for cases of admitting guilt and accepting punishment, improve the operation mechanism of the criminal expedited procedures, and promote the improvement of a multi-level criminal procedure system with Chinese characteristics. Solidly advance the pilot reform of the separation of simple and complex cases in civil procedure, and improve the civil procedure system. Improve and deepen the system and mechanism for judicial openness, deeply advance the disclosure of adjudicative documents, court hearings, trial process information, and enforcement information, and further enhance the level of informatization, standardization, and normalization of judicial openness.

8. Adhere to the deep integration of trial and enforcement work with modern technology, deepen the construction and application of smart courts

Accelerate the implementation of the "Five-Year Development Plan for the Informatization Construction of the People's Courts," study and formulate the overall design plan for the information system of the people's courts, make up for the shortcomings of intelligent services, and improve the level of informatization construction. Actively promote the in-depth application of modern technologies such as the internet, artificial intelligence, big data, cloud computing, blockchain, and 5G in the judicial field, improve smart trial, smart enforcement, smart service, and smart management levels, and achieve quality change, efficiency change, and dynamic change in judicial trials. Relying on platforms such as China Mobile Micro Court, guide parties to conduct online filing, litigation, and mediation, handle litigation matters remotely across regions, and promptly resolve conflicts and disputes online. Accelerate the construction of a unified platform for the judicial blockchain of the people's courts, promote the breakthrough of blockchain technology and the implementation of application scenarios, and form a nationally unified blockchain application system for the people's courts. Strengthen the construction of smart court laboratories, and build an international, intelligent, and open scientific research base integrating display and exchange, interactive experience, and scientific research experimentation. Expand the breadth and depth of judicial big data research, strengthen the mining and application of judicial big data, and actively serve scientific decision-making.

9. Adhere to comprehensively and strictly governing the Party, strictly governing the courts, and strictly managing, promote fair and incorruptible justice

Implement the main responsibility for comprehensively and strictly governing the Party, build a responsibility implementation system that reaches the bottom vertically and covers the entire horizontal, and create a clean and upright political ecology. Strengthen the construction of internal management systems of the people's courts, improve internal supervision mechanisms, strengthen the responsibility of the Party leadership group of the higher-level court for supervising and assisting the leadership team of the lower-level court, and supervise and guide the lower-level court to strengthen team building and party style and clean government construction. Strengthen supervision and inspection of the implementation of the spirit of the Central Committee's Eight-Point Regulation and its implementation rules, the performance of duties, judicial style, daily management, etc., and persistently rectify the "Four Forms of Decadence" and prominent issues in judicial style. Improve and refine the risk prevention and control mechanism for clean government that is compatible with the judicial responsibility system, and strengthen the supervision of the exercise of power. Precisely use the "Four Forms" of disciplinary inspection and supervision, comprehensively use criticism and education, interviews and inquiry letters, organizational handling, and disciplinary sanctions to carry out disciplinary accountability, strengthen the deterrence of not daring to be corrupt, improve the system of not being able to be corrupt, and form the consciousness of not wanting to be corrupt.

10. With a pragmatic work style and solid measures, ensure that various tasks and measures take root and achieve practical results

People's courts at all levels should strengthen organizational leadership, clarify responsibility division, effectively enhance institutional awareness, maintain institutional authority, set an example in implementing the system, unify the requirements of the Central Committee, meet practical needs, and conform to the expectations of the grassroots, unify problem-solving, practical effectiveness, and simplicity and ease of operation, focus on key points, closely monitor practical results, overcome formalism and bureaucracy, and ensure the implementation of one item after another. Improve working mechanisms, and thoroughly implement the "Implementation Opinions on Comprehensively Deepening Reform in the Political and Legal Fields" and the "Fifth Five-Year Reform Outline of the People's Courts (2019-2023)." Strengthen overall coordination, do a good job in trial enforcement, judicial reform, team building, and other tasks, promote the modernization of the trial system and trial capability, and promote the modernization of the national governance system and governance capability based on judicial functions.

March 16, 2020
